problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=-\frac{1}{4x}?$
worked_solution:
To plot $y=-\frac{1}{4x},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=-\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/9da0db2e6c97e507e82b7ca801e46802fabf91ad31ff53ad3cc9ae580151370a.png)

- Stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{1}{4}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=-\frac{1}{4x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/344a3615421b88df05cb666ca90395991f3aa6af75c9095a60c73be89124b7e9.png)
